rounds.text: The most compelling bearish evidence points to decelerating growth and deteriorating near-term operating metrics, led directly by screen flags noting that earnings growth is actively decelerating [E61]. This deceleration shows up in the quarterly numbers where the operating margin dropped to 69% in June 2026 compared to 73% in the year-ago quarter, representing a four percentage point compression [E25]. Compounded share price growth over the past year sits deeply negative at -17% [E20], and twelve-month price return is similarly depressed at -13.4% [E46], indicating that the market is already punishing the stock for slowing momentum. Furthermore, the historical price profile carries substantial risk, demonstrated by a severe worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -52.5% [E47] alongside a deeply negative Sharpe ratio of -0.63 [E49] and high annualized volatility of 42.0% [E48]. Valuation multiples also reflect considerable downside risk when compared to sector benchmarks, with the price-to-book ratio trading at an expensive 10.08x against a sector benchmark of just 3.05x [E7], and the EV/EBITDA multiple stretching to 15.9x against a sector benchmark of 10.37x [E11]. Domestic institutional investors are losing faith, cutting their holdings from 5.87% in December 2024 to 5.51% by June 2026 [E37], while company borrowings ticked upward to Rs 35 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 31 Cr a year earlier [E33]. Conceded: [E14], [E17], [E21], [E28], [E39], [E53].
